visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with glasses and short brown hair sits in a professional office or clinic setting, wearing a white lace-patterned cardigan over a crisp white shirt. She addresses the camera directly with a friendly expression. The background includes clinical certificates and a designer handbag on a cabinet. (2) The speaker picks up a black smartphone and displays a video of herself from a few months prior, looking significantly thinner and more fatigued. She points at the screen to contrast her past state with her current healthier appearance. (3) The camera captures a close-up of her face as she pinches both of her cheeks with her hands to demonstrate the increase in facial fullness. Animated pink blushes and heart graphics appear over her cheeks to emphasize her happiness. (4) The scene shifts to the woman gesturing broadly with her hands as she provides health advice. Variety-show style text overlays with bold colors and icons frequently pop up to emphasize her points about muscle mass and aging. (5) A brief cutaway to stock footage shows an elderly person with white hair lying in a bed, being covered with a white blanket by a caregiver, illustrating the risk of being bedridden. (6) Back in the office, the woman continues her explanation, at one point patting her shoulder and arm to indicate muscle placement. The video concludes with a static graphic displaying clinic logos and contact details.

A soft background hum of a room is detectable. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers a new phase as she shows her phone screen. Her vocal tone shifts into a narrative style with higher pitch variability while describing her past hospitalization. (3) A cartoonish 'sparkle' SFX plays as she pinches her cheeks. (5) The woman's voice remains the focus, with occasional pop-style SFX punctuating specific advice points. The BGM maintains a consistent, gentle presence until it fades into a final brand stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator uses her personal health journey and recovery from illness to educate middle-aged women on the critical importance of maintaining muscle mass. She reframes 'weight gain' as a positive sign of vitality and health, positioning muscle as an 'invisible asset' for the future.
